title: CanonFact
description: CanonFact v0.1 — the atom of storage (WORLD_BIBLE_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.1). Minimal fact: id, statement, type, temporalScope, provenance, consequences. Statement types are an open list governed by the distinguishable-consequence filter (Block 0.13).

statement.description: Formalized assertion, not prose. Evaluative, emotional or metaphorical statements are not Canon (they belong to Narrative Assets or to facts about cultural beliefs).

type.description: Open list: Structural, Causal, Historical, Axiomatic, Quantitative (ontology-level numbers only), EpistemicConflict, etc.

lifecycle.description: Optional per-fact narrowing; must never exceed the owning Concept status (A−10).

observability.description: Possible evidence channel, not an existing runtime sensor; Canon may lead implementation. 'Impossible' with empty consequences is forbidden.

knowledgeCost.description: Qualitative cost relative to an Observer Model, never to player progression.

source.description: Reference: ADR id, interview block/question, world id + event range, compiler version.

consequences.description: A−2: what this fact produces and what breaks if it is removed. A fact without consequences is not Canon.

supersedes.description: Fact ids superseded by this one; the only permitted correction path after a fact entered a Genesis Digest (A−16).
